name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions:
Brown the mince in a pan.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.

name: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
instructions:
Preheat oven to 220 C. Halve each butternut squash and scoop out the seeds. Sprinkle with sage, salt and pepper. Dot with butter. Roast 45 minutes to 1 hour until the squash is tender. Remove from oven, allow to cool slightly, then scoop out flesh.
Heat olive oil in a large sauce pot. Add shallot and sauté over medium-low heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Add scooped out butternut squash, chicken stock, apple cider, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, nutmeg and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a simmer and cook 30 minutes.
Puree in a blender or with an immersion blender. Return to pot, taste and adjust seasonings. At the last minute, stir in heavy cream and serve garnished with diced apple.

name: Toad in the Hole
instructions:
Turn your oven on to 220 C (200 C fan).
Place your sausages and oil into a metal roasting tin. Put the tin in the oven for 10-15 minutes until the sausages are browned and the oil is piping hot.
While the sausages cook, whisk the flour, salt, eggs, and milk together in a bowl until smooth. Let the batter rest for 15 to 20 minutes if you have time.
Carefully remove the hot tin with the sizzling sausages from the oven. Quickly pour the batter all around the sausages.
Return the tin immediately to the oven and bake for 30-35 minutes. Do not open the oven door while it cooks, or the pudding will sink.

name: Cowboy Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c. Cook the onion for 5 mins, then add mince & brown. Cook the pasta separately. Add baked beans, kidney beans and corn. Add seasoning, and Worcestershire sauce. When pasta is cooked, mix everything in a casserole dish, grate cheese on top and put in oven at 200c for 10 mins or until cheese is melted.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
instructions:
In a bowl, combine steak, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon Shaoxing wine and toss to coat. Place in refrigerator and let marinate for at least 20 minutes and up to 3 hours.
Meanwhile, combine remaining soy sauce with cornstarch and stir with a fork to form a slurry. Add remaining Shaoxing wine, chicken stock, oyster sauce, sugar, and sesame oil. Set aside. Combine garlic, ginger, and scallion whites in a bowl and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat until smoking. Add half of steak and cook without moving until well seared, about 1 minute. Continue cooking while stirring and tossing until lightly cooked but still pink in spots, about 1 minute. Transfer to a large bowl. Repeat with 1 more tablespoon of oil and remaining steak, adding to the same bowl. Wipe out wok.
Add 1 more tablespoon oil to wok and heat over high heat until smoking. Add half of broccoli and cook until crisp-tender and lightly charred, about 1 minute. Transfer to bowl with steak. Repeat with remaining oil and remaining broccoli. Return wok to high heat until smoking. Return steak and broccoli to wok and add garlic, ginger and scallion mixture. Cook, tossing and stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add sauce and scallion greens and cook, tossing and stirring constantly until lightly thickened, about 45 seconds longer. Carefully transfer to a serving platter and serve.
